lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.31 - A Look and write

details: Look and write develops reading and writing accuracy by helping students complete key vocabulary about fruit and vegetables using visual prompts.
Look for correct spelling and answers based on the images shown, and neat handwriting.
“The fruit and vegetables are entering a show - but some of their names are missing from the poster! Can you fill in the gaps?”

Heads Up: 
Focus the students’ attention on the CPT and present relevant features of the language (MFP). Then demonstrate the activity with TA/students.
Heads Down: 
Ss open their books. Instruct and ask ICQs. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.31 - B. Listen and choose

details: Listen and choose develops students’ ability to connect vocabulary with visual clues. The activity practises target vocabulary with audio support and helps build confidence in word recognition.
Look for careful listening, accurate recognition of key vocabulary, correct picture choices and most students actively participating.
“Right - they’re in pairs, ready to perform.  Can you listen and choose which ones are going to get through the first round?”

Heads Together: 
Demo/Instruct and ask ICQs, including setting behaviour expectations. Then monitor, providing support and stretch where needed. Conduct activity feedback and error correction.
Reward moment
Check behaviour expectations and reward with APOS or remind for 4Rs

Homework Check:
Have Ss open to the previous lesson’s homework. Score completion %. Conduct activity feedback and error correction. Score achievement %.

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.83 - A Find and circle

details: Find and circle develops students’ ability to recognise and locate key vocabulary about fruit and vegetables in a wordsearch. The activity reinforces spelling and reading skills.
Look for students carefully scanning the wordsearch, correctly circling target words, and staying engaged with the task.
“This is the order they are going to perform in now. Can you help me find all the names in the wordsearch so the next round of the show can begin?”

lessonPlan.topic: Activity Book p.83 - B Look and tick

details: Look and tick develops writing accuracy and comprehension by helping students match pictures of fruit and vegetables to the correct singular or plural response to a question. The activity reinforces vocabulary and basic grammar.
Look for correct matching of questions and answers, students recognising the difference between one and more than one item. and neat bookwork.

lessonPlan.topic: Student Book p.32 - Speaking What’s on My Forehead? Make a group and mix up the cards. Pick one card each. Stick it on your forehead. Guess your card. Ask and answer.

details: What’s on My Forehead develops listening and questioning skills as students describe each other’s words. Students use key vocabulary in question and answer form and practise  speaking skills in a playful context.
Look for strong teamwork, students asking and answering questions using correct vocabulary, careful listening, and showing engagement and confidence in guessing the cards.
“They were brilliant, weren’t they? Let’s play a game to celebrate!”
